name: Krzysztof Lewandowski
bio:
Krzysztof’s passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood spent watching rally races in the Polish countryside. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in precision machining, at Warsaw University of Technology. After graduation, he honed his skills working for a small engineering firm that supplied components to various racing teams across Europe. His dedication and attention to detail caught the eye of Haas F1 Team scouts, leading to his current role as a machinist. He believes in a systematic approach, prioritizing accuracy and reliability in every component he crafts. Krzysztof's meticulous nature and ability to troubleshoot complex machining issues make him a valuable asset to the team. 

Krzysztof takes immense pride in contributing to the team’s success, knowing that every part he crafts plays a role in the car's performance. His dedication to quality, combined with his deep understanding of materials science, ensures that the Haas F1 Team receives components of the highest standard. He is always eager to learn new techniques and embraces the challenges that come with working in a fast-paced, demanding environment.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Krzysztof is of average height with a stocky build.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an exact point before starting any task.
Has a collection of vintage engineering textbooks that he often consults.
Insists on cleaning his workstation thoroughly at the end of each shift, regardless of how busy the day was.
